title: Align single-arm VR collection controls
goal: Implement the approved single-arm Pico VR enable, recording, result, and reset controls in the tracked Release repository without hardware operation.
doneWhen: The implementation begins from the existing tracked Release baseline, with no replacement baseline commit required.
The approved VR control-state and button rules are persisted in the Release documentation.
VR controls implement right-menu enable/pause, left-stick recording start, Y success, X discard, and A+X reset with the approved timing and safety semantics.
Focused no-hardware tests cover the control-state transitions and existing tests remain applicable.
decisions: Use right_menu_button: release after a hold of at least 1.0 second enables VR; a shorter release pauses and locks it.
Use left_axis_click to start one recording while VR is enabled and no recording or reset is active.
Use Y to save a recording and X to discard it; neither has an effect when no recording is active.
Recognize A+X within a 100–200 ms window after 30–50 ms edge debounce. It discards an active recording and starts the configured reset without requiring VR pause.
During reset, VR movement and recording inputs are ignored; afterward VR remains enabled but grip must be released and pressed again before movement.
A/B remain inert placeholders for future DAgger; right trigger remains continuous Robotiq control and right stick click remains manual calibration.
